title: Bias of AI-Generated Content: An Examination of News Produced by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distribution of gender-specific words, sentence-level sentiment and toxicity scores, and document-level topic distributions (using LDA) between LLM-generated news articles and original human-written news articles.

Comparing the distribution of race-specific words (focusing on White, Black, and Asian groups), sentence-level sentiment and toxicity scores, and document-level topic distributions (using LDA) between LLM-generated news articles and original human-written news articles.
